mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freelancer_profiles ( user_id, nickname, introduction, github_url, website_url, school_name, major, degree, grad_status, is_profile_complete ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{introduction}, #{githubUrl}, #{websiteUrl}, #{schoolName}, #{major}, #{degree}, #{gradStatus}, #{isProfileComplete} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, nickname, introduction, github_url, website_url, school_name, major, degree, grad_status, is_profile_complete FROM freelancer_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE freelancer_profiles SET nickname = #{nickname}, introduction = #{introduction}, github_url = #{githubUrl}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, school_name = #{schoolName}, major = #{major}, degree = #{degree}, grad_status = #{gradStatus}, is_profile_complete = #{isProfileComplete} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
